abstention_gates.period_scan_boundary: diagnostic warning; no silent period substitution

models.forbidden: Held-out values cannot select time law, comparator family, hyperparameters, preprocessing, period, or error model.

multiplicity.exploratory_tests: clearly labelled and cannot promote C17
multiplicity.stratum_results: reported with bootstrap intervals as heterogeneity estimates, not separate promotion tests

primary_endpoint.population_statistic: mean paired difference with 95 percent star-level bootstrap interval

all_required: all source hashes and reuse bases verified
minimum 100 development and 50 sealed stars across ten strata
no critical provenance or leakage finding
promotion_gate.failure_policy: A failed sealed gate is reported. Sealed membership and thresholds are not edited to obtain a pass.

role_assignment.opening_policy: Open the sealed holdout once, after code, hyperparameters, metrics, and development decisions are frozen.

scientific_claim: C17: DERD is a competitive compact descriptor for prespecified strata of pulsating-star light curves.
scope_exclusions: No inference of stellar mass from normalized photometry.
No claim that fitted eccentricities are physical orbital eccentricities.
No transparent-shell prevalence or shell-mass claim.
No replacement claim for Fourier analysis outside the tested strata and metrics.

uncertainty_gate.rule: Point-prediction success cannot compensate for failed calibration.
